title: English for Life and Work: Intermediate

program.section_heading: English for Life and Work: Intermediate
outcomes: Apply and use intermediate-level correct word order, grammar, and to construct original sentences and short paragraphs in guided exercises.

Improvise intermediate-level dialogues demonstrating major social functions of language with increasing fluency and clear pronunciation to respond to a variety of social, personal, and professional situations at the intermediate level.

Read and respond to intermediate-level reading selections about everyday social and personal business comprehending expressions and vocabulary encountered in class using academic reading skills and strategies.
Write original sentences, short paragraphs, short notes, applications, and letters using vocabulary and grammar at the intermediate level.
